items.prompt: Wide 16:9 16-bit pixel art in the style of Stardew Valley, chunky square pixels of one consistent size, limited cozy palette, crisp hard edges, no blur, no anti-aliasing. Foreground: damp brick floor, the dog's mat, and a low seedling planter. Midground: dense crop rows, a narrow path, and a weathered potting bench. Background: rainy fields seen through clear greenhouse glass. Also in view: open irrigation trough beneath the roof gutter; flat rim of the near seedling planter; potting bench with a cup. soft blue dawn light through the panes, warmed by one amber lantern; crisp, consistently sized pixels with no blur or anti-aliasing. Locked-off camera at eye level, wide 16:9 composition with a clear foreground, midground and background. Leave open, uncluttered areas around the light sources, the windows and the animal so they can be animated. Things that move are animated afterwards, so do not paint them frozen: no visible steam or smoke plumes, no water drops hanging from edges and no streams of dripping water; surfaces may look wet. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no user interface.
